description: Build and submit one inference-time policy for ARC-Challenge. The same policy is evaluated against the frozen students STUDENT_C and STUDENT_D. You are scored on the smaller of the two improvements, so the policy must help both models, not trade one off against the other.
name: Joint arc_challenge improvement on STUDENT_C and STUDENT_D
submission_format: The literal string 'submission.json' - stage it with submit_policy first.
